hooks.name: Jira Workflow Rules Check
hooks.description: Run manually before complex Jira operations (story creation, assignment) to verify workflow rules like subtask inheritance and default subtask creation.

action.prompt:
Before executing any Jira operation, answer these questions:

1. If you are ASSIGNING a story: Have you also queued assignment of ALL subtasks under that story to the same person? (Squad rules: "When a story is assigned to someone, all its subtasks must also be assigned to that person by default.")

2. If you are CREATING a story: Have you also queued creation of the 4 default subtasks (Requirement Generation, Design Derivation, Code Review, Testing)?

3. If you are TRANSITIONING a subtask out of "To Do": Have you checked that the parent story is also moved to "In Progress" if it's still in "To Do"?

4. If you are creating DEVELOPMENT subtasks: Are you using the parent Story's numeric ID (not key) in the parent field?

5. If any of the above apply and you haven't addressed them: STOP and include those actions in your plan before proceeding.

Do NOT skip these checks. They are mandatory per the workflow steering and squad-rules steering files.
